title: The agent that walked into the intranet
blurb: Redirects were not re-validated against the egress profile.
prompt: A compromised page redirected the agent to an internal address and the draft followed it, because only the initial URL was checked. The same draft retried clicks and double-submitted a form. Review it, fix it, and prove every navigation is re-validated and actions are idempotent.
aiNote: The draft validates only the session's start URL and then follows any redirect or subresource the page requests, so a hostile page can reach internal services, and it retries click actions blindly, turning a timeout into a duplicate submission.
testIdea: Serve a redirect to an off-profile address and assert the navigation is blocked and recorded; time out a click and assert the agent checks page state before deciding to retry; inspect an event for typed values.
followUps: How would you let a session log in without storing credentials in the session state?
What page-state checks make a click safe to retry?
How do you budget steps for a long flow without losing resumability?
